notes: SOURCE: https://www.fmed.uba.ar/sites/default/files/2018-10/Programa%20de%20Farmacologia%20II.pdf returns HTTP 200; extract at extract/out/med-l2-farmacologia-2.txt is 1437 lines (31 pp, matches 'Agosto de 2018' cover and page-31 footer). Read in full, both pages. UNITS 19/19 FOUND verbatim in section D (line refs): 1 ANTIDEPRESIVOS L110; 2 ANTIPSICOTICOS, ANTIPARKINSONIANOS y LITIO L155; 3 ANSIOLITICOS E HIPNOTICOS NO BENZODIAZEPINICOS. FLUMAZENIL L234; 4 ANTICONVULSIVANTES L278; 5 FARMACOLOGIA RESPIRATORIA L330; 6 DIURETICOS Y ANTIDIURETICOS L426; 7 INOTROPICOS L516; 8 ANTIANGINOSOS L602; 9 ANTIARRITMICOS L652; 10 HIPOLIPEMIANTES L746; 11 ANTIHIPERTENSIVOS L796; 12 FARMACOLOGIA HEMATOLOGICA L890; 13 L950; 14 L1052; 15 L1123; 17 L1176; 18 L1236; 19 L1295; 20 L1356. Long unit names for 13/14/15/17 match the programa string-for-string, including the source's own misspelling 'ANTINFECCIOSOS' in unit 15 which the node preserves. PHANTOM 16 CONFIRMED REAL: line 1125 is literally the bare token '16)' with no title, sitting between the unit-15 heading (L1123-1124) and 'Objetivos especificos' (L1126); the objectives that follow (Vancomicina/Teicoplanina, Penicilina G/V, Ampicilina, cefalosporinas 1a-4a gen, Imipenem, Aztreonam) and the Contenido block (PENICILINAS, CEFALOSPORINAS, INHIBIDORES DE LAS B LACTAMASAS, VANCOMICINA Y TEICOPLANINA, L1157-1171) are all inhibitors of cell-wall synthesis, i.e. unit 15's subject. The node's foot note describing this is accurate. Numbering runs 1-20 with 16 void => 19 titled units, as claimed. BOOKS 6/6 FOUND in section H (L1417-1432), each with edition/publisher/year matching: Brunton 12a McGraw Hill Mexico 2012; Rang/Dale/Ritter/Flower/Henderson 7ma Elsevier Madrid 2012; Florez 6ta Elsevier Masson 2015; Katzung 13a McGraw-Hill 2016; Velazquez 18a Panamericana Buenos Aires 2009; Birkett/IUPHAR Basic Clin Pharmacol Toxicol 2010 Jul;107(1):531-59. Node correctly tags the 6th as 'articulo', not libro. No 7th reference exists; nothing in the node is invented. OMITTED: none at the exit level. The node does not expose sections B (20 objetivos generales) or C (20 habilidades y destrezas) as exits, but those are objectives, not units or refs, and are outside the L2 contract. CORRELATIVA CONTRADICTION CONFIRMED: presentacion L60-62 'Esta asignatura es correlativa de la asignatura Farmacologia I'; aspectos administrativos L1408-1410 'Para cursar Farmacologia II se requiere acreditar la regularidad de Medicina A / Para rendir el examen final, se requiere acreditar la regularidad de Medicina A' — Farmacologia I is never named in the administrative section. The node's frame states both facts and does not resolve them; metadata.correlativas carries only the administrative one. Defensible and disclosed. METADATA: '54 horas' verbatim L1414; 'tres catedras' verbatim L1402 with the three evaluation modes (orales, opcion multiple, desarrollo) and no catedra named anywhere in the PDF, so 'sin nombre' is honest; cuatrimestre 'se dicta tanto en el primero como en el segundo' verbatim L1413; 'ciclo clinico' verbatim L1412; 'Departamento Toxicologia y Farmacologia' L11. ONE SOFT SPOT (not a refutation): the word 'cuatrimestral' as regimen is never printed — the index entry 'Duracion de la asignatura' (L38) resolves to '!Error! Marcador no definido.' and that section is absent from the body, so the regimen is inferred from the oferta line. The inference is sound but rests on a field the PDF failed to render. CROSS-CLAIM CHECKED: frame's 'La bibliografia es la misma que la de Farmacologia I' verified against nodes/uba.med.medicina.farmacologia-1.json — identical six entries, same editions. Minor prose nit: the spine note orders the sweep as 'nervioso, despues cardiovascular y respiratorio' while the programa places respiratoria (5) before the cardiovascular block (6-12); descriptive only, no exit affected. No fabricated unit, no fabricated book, no unrecoverable exit. Node is clean.
